description: Structured eval definitions for the FIS Experiment Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING across EC2 stop-instances (with alarm), permissive-target rejection, Aurora failover, network blackhole via SSM, and EKS pod disruption via kubectl. Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: EC2 stop-instances on canary with CloudWatch alarm stop condition
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — fis-target=true tag, alarm in OK state, role has DescribeAlarms, tag-scoped role
eval_cases.prompt: Create an FIS experiment template named "ec2-stop-canary" in us-east-1, account 111111111111. Stop one EC2 instance tagged fis-target=true (currently 1 instance i-0abc123) for 60 seconds. Stop condition: alarm "fis-stop-error-rate" (currently OK, FIS role already has cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms on it). Log to S3 bucket "fis-logs-111111111111" prefix "experiments/" and CloudWatch Logs group "/aws/fis/ec2-stop-canary". budgetDuration 2 minutes.
eval_cases.expected_output:
EXPERIMENT_TEMPLATE: ec2-stop-canary (action: aws:ec2:stop-instances, target: fis-target=true)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Intent + blast radius: Stop one canary instance for 60s to validate auto-recovery, blast radius 1 instance
  [✓] Target scoped: resourceTags fis-target=true (1 instance i-0abc123)
  [✓] Action(s): aws:ec2:stop-instances (duration PT60S)
  [✓] Stop condition(s): fis-stop-error-rate (state: OK)
  [✓] IAM role: fis-execution-role (fis trust, ec2:StopInstances + StartInstances scoped to aws:ResourceTag/fis-target=true, cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms on fis-stop-error-rate)
  [✓] Logging: S3 fis-logs-111111111111 + CloudWatch Logs /aws/fis/ec2-stop-canary
  [✓] budgetDuration: PT2M (rationale: 2x the 60s stop action for rollback margin)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws fis get-experiment-template --id <TEMPLATE_ID>
  aws ec2 describe-instances --filters Name=tag:fis-target,Values=true --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].InstanceId'
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-names fis-stop-error-rate --query 'MetricAlarms[0].StateValue'
  aws iam get-role-policy --role-name fis-execution-role --policy-name fis-execution-policy

eval_cases.name: Permissive target tag (env=prod, 247 instances) must be rejected
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — permissive target tag, no stop condition
eval_cases.prompt: Build an FIS experiment template that stops EC2 instances tagged "env=prod" for a chaos drill. We have 247 production instances with that tag. Stop condition: none, we'll watch manually. budgetDuration 5 minutes.
eval_cases.expected_output:
EXPERIMENT_TEMPLATE: env-prod-stop (action: aws:ec2:stop-instances, target: env=prod)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Intent + blast radius: Stop production instances for a drill, blast radius unknown
  [✗] Target scoped: resourceTags env=prod matches 247 instances — refusing to deploy with this filter. Switch to fis-target=true and tag only eligible resources.
  [✓] Action(s): aws:ec2:stop-instances (duration PT60S)
  [✗] Stop condition(s): no alarm name provided — without a stop condition, the experiment runs to budget with no auto-halt. Configure an error-rate or availability alarm.
  [—] IAM role: deferred until target scope is corrected
  [—] Logging: deferred
  [✗] budgetDuration: cannot set without target + stop-condition confirmation (PT2M recommended)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ec2 describe-instances --filters Name=tag:env,Values=prod --query 'Reservations[*].Instances[0].InstanceId'
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --query 'MetricAlarms[?Namespace==`CWAgent`].AlarmName'

eval_cases.name: Aurora failover DR drill with DB connection drop alarm
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Aurora cluster AVAILABLE, alarm OK, role scoped
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an FIS experiment "aurora-failover-drill" in us-east-1. Use aws:rds:failover-db-cluster against target cluster arn:aws:rds:us-east-1:111111111111:cluster:api-prod-cluster (cluster is AVAILABLE). Stop condition: alarm "fis-stop-db-connections-dropped" (currently OK, role has cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms). Log to CloudWatch Logs group "/aws/fis/aurora-failover-drill". budgetDuration 5 minutes.
eval_cases.expected_output:
EXPERIMENT_TEMPLATE: aurora-failover-drill (action: aws:rds:failover-db-cluster, target: api-prod-cluster)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Intent + blast radius: Trigger Aurora writer failover to validate RTO, blast radius 1 cluster
  [✓] Target scoped: resourceArns arn:aws:rds:us-east-1:111111111111:cluster:api-prod-cluster (1 cluster, AVAILABLE)
  [✓] Action(s): aws:rds:failover-db-cluster (no params; irreversible, no rollback)
  [✓] Stop condition(s): fis-stop-db-connections-dropped (state: OK)
  [✓] IAM role: fis-execution-role (fis trust, rds:FailoverDBCluster on api-prod-cluster, cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms on alarm)
  [✓] Logging: CloudWatch Logs /aws/fis/aurora-failover-drill
  [✓] budgetDuration: PT5M (rationale: 2-3x the expected 30-120s failover for margin)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws fis get-experiment-template --id <TEMPLATE_ID>
  aws rds describe-db-clusters --db-cluster-identifier api-prod-cluster --query 'DBClusters[0].Status'
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-names fis-stop-db-connections-dropped --query 'MetricAlarms[0].StateValue'

eval_cases.name: Network blackhole via SSM with SSM agent verification
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SSM agent online, alarm OK, manual rollback documented
eval_cases.prompt: Create an FIS experiment "network-blackhole-app-to-db" in us-east-1. Use SSM Run Command on app instance i-0abc456 (tagged fis-target=true, SSM agent Online) to drop traffic from 10.0.0.20 (DB IP). Run for 5 minutes via SSM document AWS-RunShellScript. Stop condition: alarm "fis-stop-api-latency" (OK state, role has DescribeAlarms). Log to S3 "fis-logs-111111111111" + CloudWatch Logs "/aws/fis/network-blackhole-app-to-db". budgetDuration 10 minutes.
eval_cases.expected_output:
EXPERIMENT_TEMPLATE: network-blackhole-app-to-db (action: aws:ssm:start-automation-execution, target: fis-target=true)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Intent + blast radius: Blackhole app-to-DB traffic for 5m to test fallback circuit, blast radius 1 instance
  [✓] Target scoped: resourceTags fis-target=true (1 instance i-0abc456, SSM Online)
  [✓] Action(s): aws:ssm:start-automation-execution (AWS-RunShellScript, duration PT5M, command: iptables -I INPUT -s 10.0.0.20 -j DROP)
  [✓] Stop condition(s): fis-stop-api-latency (state: OK)
  [✓] IAM role: fis-execution-role (fis trust, ssm:SendCommand + GetCommandInvocation on AWS-RunShellScript + i-0abc456, cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms)
  [✓] Logging: S3 fis-logs-111111111111 + CloudWatch Logs /aws/fis/network-blackhole-app-to-db
  [✓] budgetDuration: PT10M (rationale: 2x the 5m disruption for SSM rollback margin; manual rollback runbook: iptables -D + tc qdisc del)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws fis get-experiment-template --id <TEMPLATE_ID>
  aws ssm describe-instance-information --filters Name=InstanceIds,Values=i-0abc456 --query 'InstanceInformationList[0].PingStatus'
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-names fis-stop-api-latency --query 'MetricAlarms[0].StateValue'

eval_cases.name: EKS pod disruption via kubectl on worker node (SSM)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — worker has SSM + kubeconfig, alarm OK
eval_cases.prompt: Build an FIS experiment "eks-pod-kill-api" in us-east-1. Use SSM Run Command on EKS worker node i-0abc789 (tagged fis-target=true, SSM agent Online, has EKS API permissions via kubeconfig). Delete pods matching label "app=critical" in namespace "api". Run kubectl via AWS-RunShellScript. Stop condition: alarm "fis-stop-api-5xx" (OK state, role has DescribeAlarms). budgetDuration 3 minutes.
eval_cases.expected_output:
EXPERIMENT_TEMPLATE: eks-pod-kill-api (action: aws:ssm:start-automation-execution, target: fis-target=true)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Intent + blast radius: Delete api/critical pods to validate controller reschedule, blast radius 1 worker node / N pods
  [✓] Target scoped: resourceTags fis-target=true (1 worker i-0abc789, SSM Online, kubeconfig verified)
  [✓] Action(s): aws:ssm:start-automation-execution (AWS-RunShellScript: kubectl delete pod -n api -l app=critical --grace-period=0 --force)
  [✓] Stop condition(s): fis-stop-api-5xx (state: OK)
  [✓] IAM role: fis-execution-role (fis trust, ssm:SendCommand on AWS-RunShellScript + worker, cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms)
  [✓] Logging: CloudWatch Logs /aws/fis/eks-pod-kill-api
  [✓] budgetDuration: PT3M (rationale: 3x the expected pod-reschedule window for margin)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws fis get-experiment-template --id <TEMPLATE_ID>
  aws ssm describe-instance-information --filters Name=InstanceIds,Values=i-0abc789 --query 'InstanceInformationList[0].PingStatus'
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-names fis-stop-api-5xx --query 'MetricAlarms[0].StateValue'
